# One requirement per line; format: <source-L-doc>: <description>

L10: 32-bit DATA WORD with each of the three data encodings (BNR, BCD, Discrete) and mixed encodings within the data field.
L10: Bit transmission order: Bit 1 first → Bit 32 last on the wire; Label field MSB-first within bits 1-8.
L10: BRZ waveform per bit: first-half HI (or LO) + second-half NULL; verify mid-bit return-to-zero edge.
L10: Bit-rate sweep: low speed (12.5 kbit/s + 12 / 14.5 tolerance corners) and high speed (100 kbit/s).
L10: Word time at high speed = 320 µs; minimum word-to-word period ≥ 360 µs (4-bit-time NULL gap).
L10: Inter-word NULL gap < 4 bit-times → framing-error detection at receiver.
L10: Odd-parity check on bits 1-31 vs bit 32: single-bit-flip detection (all 32 positions).
L10: Odd-multiplicity bit flips (3, 5, 7, ...) detected; even-multiplicity (2, 4, 6, ...) NOT detected by parity alone.
L10: Label-filter pass/drop: label in acceptance list → forwarded; label not in list → dropped.
L10: SSM encoding per BCD data: 00 Plus/N/E/R/To/Above, 01 NCD, 10 FT, 11 Minus/S/W/L/From/Below.
L10: SSM encoding per BNR data: 00 FW, 01 NCD, 10 FT, 11 NO (with Bit 29 = sign).
L10: SSM encoding per Discrete data: 00 Verified Data/NO, 01 NCD, 10 FT, 11 FW.
L10: BNR sign bit (Bit 29) = 0 → Plus; = 1 → Minus.
L10: Electrical: drive HI ≈ +10 V differential, LO ≈ -10 V, NULL ≈ 0 V; verify receiver thresholds ±2.5 V; verify common-mode
L10: Receiver loading: up to 20 receivers in parallel — verify rise/fall times remain within spec under maximum loading.
L10: Cable: shielded 78 Ω twisted-pair; impedance-mismatch and reflection sensitivity at boundary cases.
L10: Periodic re-transmission cadence: each label transmitted at its fixed update rate per equipment-type spec; verify no int
L10: Label table conformance: each transmitting subsystem emits its assigned labels (per ARINC 429 Part 1-17 Sections 78-116)
L10: Example reference word: Label 260 (octal) with the standard's example BCD time-of-day data; verify field-by-field decode
L16: Transmit each word as a 32-bit fixed-length sequence with Bit 1 first → Bit 32 last on the wire.
L16: Bits 1-8 = Label (octal); Label is transmitted MSB-first within the label field.
L16: Bits 9-10 = SDI (Source/Destination Identifier).
L16: Bits 11-29 = Data field (19 bits); encodings BNR / BCD / Discrete; mixed permitted.
L16: Bits 30-31 = SSM (Sign/Status Matrix); encoding depends on data representation.
L16: Bit 32 = Parity bit; odd parity over bits 1-31.
L16: Bipolar return-to-zero (BRZ / BPRZ) line encoding: HI = +10 V differential first half + NULL second half; LO = -10 V dif
L16: Inter-word gap ≥ 4 bit-times of NULL state (≥ 40 µs at 100 kbit/s; ≥ 320 µs at 12.5 kbit/s).
L16: Bit rate: 12.5 kbit/s (low speed; equipment tolerance band 12-14.5 kbit/s) or 100 kbit/s (high speed); a single bus runs
L16: Single transmitter, ≤ 20 receivers per bus.
L16: Shielded 78 Ω twisted-pair cabling.
L16: Drive levels: ±10 V differential (e.g. +5 V on DataA / -5 V on DataB); ±5 V single-ended.
L16: Receiver thresholds: differential > +2.5 V = HI; < -2.5 V = LO; in between = NULL.
L16: Common-mode rejection ≥ 6.5 V.
L16: For BNR-encoded data, Bit 29 = sign (0 = Plus, 1 = Minus); SSM carries Status Matrix only.
L16: SSM encoding per BCD / BNR / Discrete matrix exactly as specified in the standard's SSM table.
L16: Label assignments per equipment type follow ARINC 429 Part 1-17 Sections 78-116.
